Page No.# 2/2 The charge-sheet has been filed u/s 376 of the Indian Penal Code and no witness has been examined till now.

sentences.text: As the name of 11 witnesses have been shown in the charge-sheet, the petitioner is adviced to approach this Court again after examination and cross-examination of the victim.

On receipt of the said evidence, this matter shall be listed again.

opennyai_summary.facts:
